title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4EHAW - Patient
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ehaw/Patient. A user of the type patient, i.e. a cared-for person by one or multiple caregivers (ttl rdfs:comment). Modelled as a subClassOf User (itself a subClassOf HealthActor). The source ttl declares no rdfs:domain property for Patient itself -- it is a pure specialization. It therefore inherits every property of User (hasHabit, hasImpairment, hasChronicDisease, posture) and, transitively, of HealthActor (firstName, lastName, dob, phone, hasMbox, gender, ageCategory, hasPhysicalLocation, usesBan, hasActivity) with nothing of its own declared in the source ontology. Patient is the range of Caregiver.hasPatient and of ObservationCollectionExecution.observes.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Patient'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.
